scope.summary: The parser square-bracket pre-budget counts only code brackets: string literals, Oracle q-quoted literals, line/block comments and (since 5fe1cf0f) double-quoted identifiers do not consume it, while the b41nq reproducer and the IF"'" quoted-identifier bypass stay bounded and refused.
out_of_scope: Other classifier budgets and the served strict-mode semantic proof.

entry_points.name: semantic_read_plan_checked / Classifier::classify (public guard API used by the served read path)
entry_points.trace: Out-of-tree release harness against a clean export of ef2885a5: original b41nq reproducer 11.7us (plan) / 62us (classify, Forbidden 'parser square-bracket budget'); IF"'" bypass 0.5us / 1.4us; 15 verifier-invented q-quote-in-identifier prefixes plus CR-comment and doubled-quote variants all refused in <=258us; bracket data in literal, q-quote, quoted identifier, block and line comment admitted Safe with a plan.

entry_points.name: guard regression tests (verifier re-execution)
entry_points.trace: cargo test -p oraclemcp-guard --test adversarial_corpus: 18 passed (semantic_read_plan_fuzz_square_bracket_budget_refuses_without_parser_backtracking includes the quoted-identifier bypass; classifier_square_bracket_budget_spares_literal_and_comment_data includes the quoted identifier); cargo test -p oraclemcp-guard --lib: 369 passed.

limitations: The >=300s classify_fuzz campaign was not re-run by the verifier (instructed not to hold the build lease for fuzz builds); the implementer's campaign log was read and ran from the shared checkout, not from a clean tree at ef2885a5.
Timing is a bounded-work proof on this host, not a formal complexity bound.
